mapper.select: select shopno from user_mst where custcd = '0001'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sms_data ( kindshop, memno, memname, sendkey, seq, handno, callno, stat, sdate, stime, msg, subname ) VALUES ( #{kindshopno}, '99999999999999', #{custcd}, #{sendkey}, 1, #{handno}, #{recvno}, '', DATEFORMAT(GETDATE(),'YYYYMMDD'), DATEFORMAT(GETDATE(),'HHNNSS'), #{msg}, 'WEB' )

INSERT INTO send_mst ( kind, kindshop, sendkey, syymm, sdate, stime, remk, totcnt, success, fail, sendkindshop, intot, incnt, inservice, finish ) VALUES ( left(#{kindshopno},2), #{kindshopno}, #{sendkey}, DATEFORMAT(GETDATE(),'YYYYMM'), DATEFORMAT(GETDATE(),'YYYYMMDD'), DATEFORMAT(GETDATE(),'HHNNSS'), 'WEB', 1, 1, 0, #{custcd}, 0, 0, 0, '' )

INSERT INTO sms_send_data (custcd, seq, handno, memo, prdate, prtime, recvno) VALUES ( #{custcd}, (select isnull(max(seq),0) + 1 from sms_send_data where custcd = #{custcd}), #{handno}, #{msg}, DATEFORMAT(GETDATE(),'YYYYMMDD'), DATEFORMAT(GETDATE(),'HHNNSS'), #{recvno} )
mapper.select: SELECT custcd AS CUSTCD, seq AS SEQ, handno AS HANDNO, memo AS MEMO, prdate AS PRDATE, prtime AS PRTIME, recvno AS RECVNO FROM sms_send_data WHERE custcd = #{custcd} ORDER BY seq desc

SELECT CUSTCD, CUSTNAME, OWNER, TELNO, HANDNO, SANO, ADDR1 + ADDR2 ADDR, REMK, PRDATE FROM CUST_MST WHERE CHK = 'Y' AND MIMC = '매출'
AND CUSTNAME LIKE '%' || #{custname} || '%'
AND OWNER LIKE '%' || #{owner} || '%'
AND HANDNO LIKE '%' || #{handno} || '%'
AND SANO LIKE '%' || #{sano} || '%'
ORDER BY CUSTNAME

SELECT JEPMCD1 JEPMCD, JEPMCD JEPMNO, JEPMNM, PRICE, SALEPRICE, BARCD FROM JEPM_MST WHERE CHK = 'Y'
AND JEPMCD1 LIKE #{jepmcd} || '%'
AND BARCD LIKE #{barcode} || '%'
AND JEPMNM LIKE '%' || #{jepmnm} || '%'
ORDER BY JEPMNM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MC20_MST ( BUSEO, JPNO, CDATE, CUSTCD, GUBUN, AMT, BANPUM, TOT, INAMT, SKNO, SKAMT, SKSALE, LIST, REMK, PRDATE, PRTIME, PRUSER, LISTDATE, LISTREDATE, BONUSAMT, BONUSUSE, TAXAMT, SENDSEQ, LOADJPNO) SELECT '0001',#{jpno},#{cdate},#{custcd}, '매출', SUM(AMT) ,0 , SUM(AMT), 0,'',0,0, '','WEB',DATEFORMAT(GETDATE(),'YYYYMMDD'),DATEFORMAT(GETDATE(),'HHNNSS'), 'SENSCOM','','',0, 0,0,0,'' FROM MC20_DTL WHERE JPNO = #{jpno}
mapper.select: SELECT m.jpno AS JPNO, m.custcd AS CUSTCD, c.custname AS CUSTNAME, m.cdate AS CDATE, m.amt AS AMT FROM mc20_mst m LEFT OUTER JOIN cust_mst c ON c.custcd = m.custcd WHERE m.buseo = '0001' AND m.gubun = '매출' AND m.cdate >= #{fromDate} AND m.cdate <= #{toDate} AND m.custcd = #{custcd} AND c.custname LIKE '%' + #{custname} + '%' ORDER BY m.cdate DESC, m.jpno DESC

SELECT TOP 1 m.custcd AS CUSTCD, m.jpno AS JPNO, c.custname AS CUSTNAME, c.owner AS OWNER, c.handno AS HANDNO, c.sano AS SANO, m.cdate AS CDATE FROM mc20_mst m LEFT OUTER JOIN cust_mst c ON c.custcd = m.custcd WHERE m.jpno = #{jpno}

SELECT seq AS SEQ, d.jepmcd AS JEPMNO, j.jepmcd1 AS JEPMCD, j.jepmnm AS JEPMNM, j.price AS PRICE, d.price AS SALEPRICE, d.qty AS QTY, d.amt AS AMT, d.remk AS REMK FROM mc20_dtl d,jepm_mst j WHERE d.jepmcd = j.jepmcd and d.jpno = #{jpno} ORDER BY seq

SELECT MC20_MST.JPNO, MC20_MST.CDATE CDATE, '매출' MCSK, MC20_MST.AMT AMT, MC20_MST.BANPUM BANPUM, MC20_MST.BONUSAMT , MC20_MST.BONUSUSE , MC20_MST.PRUSER PRUSER, 0 CASHAMT , 0 SALEAMT , CONVERT(NUMERIC ,0) MISU , '' REMK, 'SOS' GUBUN FROM MC20_MST WHERE MC20_MST.CUSTCD = #{custcd} AND MC20_MST.BUSEO = '0001' UNION ALL SELECT KJSK_MST.JPNO, KJSK_MST.KJSKDATE CDATE, '수금' MCSK, 0, 0, 0, 0, KJSK_MST.PRUSER , KJSK_MST.CASHAMT , KJSK_MST.SALEAMT , 0 MISU , TRIM(KJSK_MST.REMK) + ' ' + TRIM(KJSK_MST.KINDCONT) REMK , 'SOS' GUBUN FROM KJSK_MST WHERE KJSK_MST.CUSTCD = #{custcd} AND KJSK_MST.BUSEO = '0001' ORDER BY 2,3,1
SELECT custcd AS CUSTCD, seq AS SEQ, memo AS MEMO, prdate AS PRDATE, plandate AS PLANDATE FROM MEMO_TBL WHERE custcd = #{custcd} ORDER BY seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMO_TBL (custcd, seq, memo, prdate, plandate) VALUES (#{custcd}, #{seq}, #{memo}, #{prdate}, #{plandate, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT u.custname AS NAME, u.owner AS OWNER, u.sano AS SANO, u.telno AS TEL, (u.soaddr + u.subaddr) AS ADDR FROM user_mst u WHERE u.custcd = '0001'

SELECT TOP 1 m.custcd AS CUSTCD, m.jpno AS JPNO, m.cdate AS CDATE, c.custname AS CUSTNAME, c.owner AS OWNER, c.handno AS HANDNO, c.sano AS SANO FROM mc20_mst m LEFT OUTER JOIN cust_mst c ON m.custcd = c.custcd WHERE m.jpno = #{jpno}

SELECT d.seq AS SEQ, j.jepmcd1 AS JEPMCD, j.jepmnm AS JEPMNM, d.qty AS QTY, d.price AS SALEPRICE, d.amt AS AMT, d.taxamt AS TAXAMT, d.totamt AS TOTAMT, d.remk AS REMK FROM mc20_mst m, mc20_dtl d, jepm_mst j WHERE m.jpno = d.jpno AND d.jepmcd = j.jepmcd AND m.jpno = #{jpno} ORDER BY d.seq
mapper.update: UPDATE SUBUL_TB SET SALE = SALE - (SELECT SUM(QTY) FROM MC20_DTL D WHERE D.JEPMCD = S.JEPMCD AND JPNO = #{OLDJPNO}) ,JEGO = JEGO + (SELECT SUM(QTY) FROM MC20_DTL D WHERE D.JEPMCD = S.JEPMCD AND JPNO = #{OLDJPNO}) FROM SUBUL_TB S WHERE YYMM = #{YYMM} AND JEPMCD IN (SELECT JEPMCD FROM MC20_DTL WHERE JPNO = #{OLDJPNO})

UPDATE SUBUL_TB SET SALE = SALE + (SELECT SUM(QTY) FROM MC20_DTL D WHERE D.JEPMCD = S.JEPMCD AND JPNO = #{jpno}) ,JEGO = JEGO - (SELECT SUM(QTY) FROM MC20_DTL D WHERE D.JEPMCD = S.JEPMCD AND JPNO = #{jpno}) FROM SUBUL_TB S WHERE YYMM = #{YYMM} AND JEPMCD IN (SELECT JEPMCD FROM MC20_DTL WHERE JPNO = #{jpno})
mapper.insert:
SELECT SUM(AMT) SUMAMT FROM MC20_DTL WHERE JPNO = #{JPNO}
INSERT INTO MC20_MST ( BUSEO, JPNO, CDATE, CUSTCD, GUBUN, AMT, BANPUM, TOT, INAMT, SKNO, SKAMT, SKSALE, LIST, REMK, PRDATE, PRTIME, PRUSER, LISTDATE, LISTREDATE, BONUSAMT, BONUSUSE, TAXAMT, SENDSEQ, LOADJPNO) VALUES (#{BUSEO},#{JPNO},#{CDATE},#{CUSTCD}, '매출', #{SUMAMT} ,0 , #{SUMAMT}, 0,'',0,0, '','WEB',DATEFORMAT(GETDATE(),'YYYYMMDD'),DATEFORMAT(GETDATE(),'HHNNSS'), #{USERID},'','',0, 0,0,0,'')
mapper.update: UPDATE SUBUL_TB SET SALE = SALE + #{QTY}, JEGO = JEGO - #{QTY} WHERE BUSEO = #{MST.BUSEO} AND JEPMCD = #{CODEKEY} AND YYMM = #{MST.YYMM} AND SHOPNO = '000000'

UPDATE SUBUL_TB SET SALE = SALE + (SELECT SUM(QTY) FROM MC20_DTL D WHERE D.JEPMCD = S.JEPMCD AND JPNO = #{OLDJPNO}) ,JEGO = JEGO - (SELECT SUM(QTY) FROM MC20_DTL D WHERE D.JEPMCD = S.JEPMCD AND JPNO = #{OLDJPNO}) FROM SUBUL_TB S WHERE YYMM = #{YYMM} AND JEPMCD IN (SELECT JEPMCD FROM MC20_DTL WHERE JPNO = #{OLDJPNO})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SUBUL_TB (BUSEO, YYMM, JEPMCD, SALE, JEGO, SHOPNO) SELECT #{MST.BUSEO}, #{MST.YYMM}, #{CODEKEY}, #{QTY}, - #{QTY},'000000' FROM DUMMY WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT JEPMCD FROM SUBUL_TB J WHERE J.BUSEO = #{MST.BUSEO} AND J.JEPMCD = #{CODEKEY} AND J.YYMM = #{MST.YYMM} AND J.SHOPNO = '000000')
mapper.select: SELECT SABUNNM ,CUSTCD ,CUSTNAME ,OWNER ,TELNO ,HANDNO ,ADDR1 + ADDR2 ADDR ,FN_GET_CUST_MISU(#{BUSEO},CUSTCD,DATEFORMAT(MONTHS(NOW(), -1), 'yyyymm')) MISUAMT FROM CUST_MST WHERE BUSEO = #{BUSEO} AND MIMC = #{MIMC} AND (CUSTNAME LIKE #{FIND} + '%' OR TELNO LIKE '%' + #{FIND} OR HANDNO LIKE '%' + #{FIND} OR OWNER LIKE '%' + #{FIND} OR REMK LIKE '%' + #{FIND}) AND CHK = 'Y'
SELECT DISTINCT BRAND FROM JEPM_MST WHERE GUBUN = #{BUSEO} AND CHK = 'Y' ORDER BY 1

SELECT SUM(EWOL) EWOL,SUM(MCAMT) MCAMT,SUM(BANPUM) BANPUM,SUM(CASH) SKAMT,SUM(SALE) SALEAMT,SUM(MISU) JANAMT FROM ( SELECT JANAMT EWOL,0 MCAMT,0 BANPUM,0 CASH,0 SALE,JANAMT MISU FROM KJSK_TB WHERE BUSEO = '0001' AND CUSTCD = #{CUSTCD} AND YYMM = DATEFORMAT(DATEADD(MONTH, -1, CAST(#{FRDATE} AS DATE)), 'YYYYMM') UNION ALL SELECT SUM(AMT - BANPUM),0,0,0,0,SUM(AMT - BANPUM) FROM MC20_MST WHERE BUSEO = '0001' AND CUSTCD = #{CUSTCD} AND GUBUN = '매출' AND CDATE BETWEEN LEFT(#{FRDATE},6) + '00' AND CAST(CAST(#{TODATE} AS INT) - 1 AS VARCHAR(8)) UNION ALL SELECT -SUM(CASHAMT + SALEAMT),0,0,0,0,-SUM(CASHAMT + SALEAMT) FROM KJSK_MST WHERE BUSEO = '0001' AND KJSKGU = '수금' AND CUSTCD = #{CUSTCD} AND KJSKDATE BETWEEN LEFT(#{FRDATE},6) + '00' AND CAST(CAST(#{TODATE} AS INT) - 1 AS VARCHAR(8)) UNION ALL SELECT 0,SUM(AMT),SUM(BANPUM),0,0,SUM(AMT - BANPUM) FROM MC20_MST WHERE BUSEO = '0001' AND CUSTCD = #{CUSTCD} AND GUBUN = '매출' AND CDATE BETWEEN #{FRDATE} AND #{TODATE} UNION ALL SELECT 0,0,0,SUM(CASHAMT),SUM(SALEAMT),-SUM(CASHAMT + SALEAMT) FROM KJSK_MST WHERE BUSEO = '0001' AND KJSKGU = '수금' AND CUSTCD = #{CUSTCD} AND KJSKDATE BETWEEN #{FRDATE} AND #{TODATE} ) AS T

SELECT CUSTCD,#{YYMM} + '99' CDATE,#{YYMM} + '99' JPNO,1 SEQ,'이월' GUBUN,0 MCAMT,0 SKAMT,JANAMT MISUAMT FROM KJSK_TB WHERE BUSEO = #{BUSEO} AND CUSTCD = #{CUSTCD} AND YYMM = #{YYMM} AND MIMCGU = '수금' UNION ALL SELECT CUSTCD,CDATE,JPNO,1 SEQ,'매출' GUBUN,AMT MCAMT,0 SKAMT,0 JANAMT FROM MC20_MST WHERE BUSEO = #{BUSEO} AND CUSTCD = #{CUSTCD} AND CDATE > #{YYMM} + '99' AND GUBUN = '매출' AND AMT <> 0 UNION ALL SELECT CUSTCD,CDATE,JPNO,2 SEQ,'반품' GUBUN,BANPUM MCAMT,0 SKAMT,0 JANAMT FROM MC20_MST WHERE BUSEO = #{BUSEO} AND CUSTCD = #{CUSTCD} AND CDATE > #{YYMM} + '99' AND GUBUN = '매출' AND BANPUM <> 0 UNION ALL SELECT CUSTCD,KJSKDATE,JPNO,1 SEQ,'수금' GUBUN,0 MCAMT,CASHAMT SKAMT,0 JANAMT FROM KJSK_MST WHERE BUSEO = #{BUSEO} AND CUSTCD = #{CUSTCD} AND KJSKDATE > #{YYMM} + '99' AND KJSKGU = '수금' AND CASHAMT <> 0 UNION ALL SELECT CUSTCD,KJSKDATE,JPNO,2 SEQ,'할인' GUBUN,0 MCAMT,SALEAMT SKAMT,0 JANAMT FROM KJSK_MST WHERE BUSEO = #{BUSEO} AND CUSTCD = #{CUSTCD} AND KJSKDATE > #{YYMM} + '99' AND KJSKGU = '수금' AND SALEAMT <> 0 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT M.CUSTCD,C.CUSTNAME,M.CDATE,M.JPNO,'매출' GUBUN,M.AMT,M.BANPUM BANPUM,0 SKAMT,0 SALEAMT,0 JANAMT FROM MC20_MST M,CUST_MST C WHERE M.CUSTCD = C.CUSTCD AND M.BUSEO = #{BUSEO} AND M.CDATE BETWEEN #{STARTDATE} AND #{ENDDATE} AND M.GUBUN = '매출' UNION ALL SELECT K.CUSTCD,C.CUSTNAME,KJSKDATE,K.JPNO,'수금' GUBUN,0 MCAMT,0 BANPUM,CASHAMT SKAMT,SALEAMT SALE,0 JANAMT FROM KJSK_MST K,CUST_MST C WHERE K.CUSTCD = C.CUSTCD AND K.BUSEO = #{BUSEO} AND K.KJSKDATE BETWEEN #{STARTDATE} AND #{ENDDATE} AND K.KJSKGU = '수금' ORDER BY 2,3,4

SELECT C.CUSTNAME CUSTNAME ,M.JPNO JPNO ,M.CUSTCD CUSTCD ,M.CDATE CDATE ,M.GUBUN GUBUN ,M.TOT TOTAMT ,0 CASHAMT ,0 SALEAMT ,M.REMK ,D.SEQ SEQ ,D.JEPMCD JEPMCD ,J.JEPMCD1 JEPMCD1 ,J.BRAND BRAND ,J.JEPMNM JEPMNM ,J.PRICE PRICE ,D.PRICE SALEPRICE ,D.QTY QTY ,D.AMT FROM CUST_MST C,MC20_MST M,MC20_DTL D,JEPM_MST J WHERE M.CUSTCD = C.CUSTCD AND M.JPNO = D.JPNO AND D.JEPMCD = J.JEPMCD AND M.JPNO = #{JPNO} UNION ALL SELECT C.CUSTNAME ,K.JPNO JPNO ,K.CUSTCD ,K.KJSKDATE ,K.KJSKGU ,0 ,K.CASHAMT ,K.SALEAMT ,K.REMK ,0 ,'' ,'' ,'' ,'' ,0 ,0 ,0 ,0 FROM CUST_MST C,KJSK_MST K WHERE K.CUSTCD = C.CUSTCD AND K.JPNO = #{JPNO}
